scripts.build:client: dotnet fable Client -o Client/build && vite build
scripts.dev:client: dotnet fable watch Client -o Client/build-dev -c Debug --run vite
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n client,server -c cyan,green "dotnet fable watch Client -o Client/build-dev -c Debug --run vite" "nodemon --quiet --delay 3 --signal SIGINT --watch Shared --watch Server --ext fs,html --exec \"dotnet build Server -p:SkipClientBuild=true --nologo -v q && exec dotnet Server/bin/Debug/net10.0/Demo.Server.dll --hmr\""
